en.headline: CAVALLUNA plays its last Hong Kong dates this weekend at Kai Tak
en.dek: The European equestrian theatre production, making its Asian debut, has remaining performances through Sunday at Kai Tak Arena, with tickets from HK$395.
body: CAVALLUNA – Gate to the Otherworld, a European equestrian theatre production on its first Asian stop, has its remaining Hong Kong performances this weekend at Kai Tak Arena.

Kai Tak Sports Park and the show's organisers list dates on 8 September and from 10 to 13 September at the Arena Grand Hall, 38 Shing Kai Road. Remaining public performances run tonight, twice on Saturday and twice on Sunday. The production uses 54 horses, among them Lusitanos, Andalusians, Friesians, Arabians and miniature ponies from Ischia, with an international dance ensemble and a spoken English narration carrying Traditional and Simplified Chinese subtitles. The running time is about two and a half hours, including a 25-minute interval.

The Hong Kong Jockey Club is the exclusive presenting partner and cultural host. Tickets are sold through HK Ticketing, with published prices from HK$395 to HK$1,995 for standard seating and a separate VIP table category. The venue is at Kai Tak, Kowloon.

zh.headline: 歐洲馬術劇場CAVALLUNA本周末在啟德上演最後場次
zh.dek: 亞洲首站餘下場次今晚至周日在啟德體藝館舉行，普通票由395元起，由香港賽馬會呈獻。
body: 歐洲馬術劇場《CAVALLUNA 馬術X劇場 穿梭異境》首次來亞洲，本周末在啟德體藝館上演香港站餘下場次。
啟德體育園及主辦單位公布，演出日期為9月8日及10日至13日，地點為承啟道38號啟德體藝館競技場。公眾場次今晚、周六下午及晚上、周日下午及晚上仍有餘場。製作動員54匹馬，包括盧西塔諾、安達盧西亞、弗里斯蘭、阿拉伯馬及來自伊斯基亞島的迷你馬，並有國際舞蹈團演出，旁白為英語，配繁體及簡體中文字幕。全場約兩小時半，中場休息25分鐘。
香港賽馬會為獨家呈獻及文化合作夥伴。門票經快達票發售，已公布的普通票價由395元至1,995元，另設貴賓桌類別。場館位於九龍啟德。
